title: Jesus, How Long Do I Have to Wait for This?

bible.text: For the revelation awaits an appointed time; it speaks of the end and will not prove false. Though it linger, wait for it; it will certainly come and will not delay.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... how long do I have to wait for this?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I've been praying for the same thing for so long, and nothing's changed yet.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Waiting isn't wasted time. Something is being prepared, even in what looks like nothing happening.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But what if it never comes? What if I'm just waiting for nothing?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: What I promise doesn't depend on how long it takes to arrive.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: It's just hard to keep hoping when I don't see anything move.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Then hold on a little longer. What's coming is worth every bit of the wait.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Maybe the waiting isn't Me forgetting you. Maybe it's Me preparing you for what's next.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What are you still waiting on right now?
